narrative.overview: The product is a lifter's logbook on graph paper. The whole app is one ruled page: a cool blue-white sheet with a faint grid, navy ink for everything written, and a single red pen for everything done, chosen or primary. A set is a 1.5px ink box; ticking it draws a red check, and a finished exercise is struck through with a red line. Structure comes from ruled lines, not boxes and shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Graph-paper ground, 24px minor grid with a stronger line every 120px.
One red pen (#c8322a) for strikes, checks, the margin rule, focus and the primary action.
Ruled lines and 1.5px ink outlines instead of cards; shadow reserved for three loose-sheet cases.
Ticking a set draws a red pen stroke left to right.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: There is one accent and it is red. No second hue, no gradient, no tints other than Red Wash. If something is blue it is ink.

rules.name: The Solid Wash Rule
rules.body: Red Wash is a solid color, never an alpha overlay, so contrast against text is computed against a real background.

rules.name: The Handwriting Has A Job Rule
rules.body: Kalam is for the numbered questions and short human notes only. It never sets headings, buttons, labels or body text.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Sets, reps, loads, dates and counts use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Three Sheets Rule
rules.body: Shadow belongs to the landing sample page, the dashboard today page and forms. Plan days, lists, weekly strip, buttons and inputs get none.

rules.name: The No Blur Rule
rules.body: No decorative blur, glow or backdrop filter.

dos: Do express structure with ruled lines: 1.5px ink for outlines and section rules, 1px Grid Strong for row dividers.
Do use Red Pen only for what is done, chosen, focused or the single primary action per screen; use Red Ink for small red text.
Do keep radius at 3px (2px on boxes) and borders at 1.5px ink.
Do keep headings in Archivo 800 at width 78% and body in Atkinson; keep inputs at 16px or more.
Do make every tappable target 44px or larger and gate hover behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
Do author new pictograms as SVG symbols in the sprite, in the same front/back figure with a red target region.
Do show only real content; the sample plan is labeled as an example.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow, kicker or small label above a heading.
Don't use emoji or glyph characters as icons; use the authored SVG sprite.
Don't nest cards inside cards, and don't box plan days, lists or summaries; use rules.
Don't use gradient text, decorative blur, glow, or any shadow outside the three sheet cases.
Don't add a second accent color, or an alpha-tinted wash over text.
Don't invent prices, testimonials, user counts or metric tiles.
Don't set Kalam on headings, buttons or running text.
Don't use a dark theme, a hero card, a badge row or a scroll cue.
